meta.what: Round 53: is a band measured only on captive energy flows (Russia >= 70% of the product's imports, no sea route) narrower than the site's general band for 'paid', and does it hold out of sample?
meta.units: multipliers on the summed expected (held-flat) level; H1-H5, H5 with the fifth year at 8/12 (the site's 2022-2026 with 2026 at 8 of 12 months)

rule.written: 2026-10-25 22:05 UTC, before any back-test result was computed
rule.captive_flow: a country x energy product (HS 2701 coal, 2709 crude, 2710 oil products, 2711 gas) is CAPTIVE when (1) Russia's share of the country's imports of that product is >= 70%, averaged over the reference years (2017-2021 for the 2022-2026 application; the four years to the origin, o-3..o, in the back-test, so no window is selected on its own future), (2) the product could not reach the country by sea: the country is landlocked (UN LLDC list), or the product is natural gas and the country had no LNG import terminal feeding its grid in that year, and (3) the flow averaged at least EUR 10 m a year over the reference years at fixed 2019-2021 unit values
rule.data_sets: shares and volumes from Eurostat energy imports by country of origin (gas TJ GCV, crude and oil products kt, coal kt) for the countries Eurostat covers (EU, Western Balkans, Moldova, Georgia, Turkiye, Norway, UK); CEPII BACI elsewhere (Russia's exports to the country in tonnes; shares on value). One data set per country. Fixed 2019-2021 unit values to add products (round 8): crude EUR 370/t, products 420/t, pipeline gas EUR 4.67/GJ (249/t in BACI tonnes at 53.4 GJ/t), coal 60/t. BACI tonnes are used only when the unit value is within x1/3-x3 of the world unit value of the heading that year (else missing). Eurostat exact zeros between positive years are missing (round 8 cleaning)
rule.unit_of_test: a country's captive energy basket at an origin o (the sum of its captive products at o), in volume at fixed unit values; the centre is HELD FLAT at the origin year (as the site's to_rus centre); the error is the site's cumulative error log(sum w x actual / sum w x predicted), H = 1..5, w = 1 except 8/12 for the fifth year. Origins 2005-2016 for the band; 2017 only for the 2018 placebo. Ukraine and Russia are left out; Belarus is in
rule.band: era-calibrated 90% band (round 7/48 method: 5th-95th percentile of the pooled errors x K, K the smallest factor >= 0.5 at which bands from two eras cover >= 90% of the third; eras 2005-09, 2010-12, 2013-16), per horizon
accept_pooled_if_all: (a) narrower: the H5 captive band's log width is smaller than the current site band for those flows: the generic band of large purchases x CB_SCALE_PAID (0.652-1.500 for 2022-2026), the band almost every captive country carries
(b) coverage: leave-era-out (band from the other two eras x K) coverage of the H5 errors >= 80% at EACH origin 2005-2016 and >= 90% pooled

(c) placebo: the band built only from origins whose windows end before the placebo window (x K) covers >= 90% of the captive windows for the war moved to 2014 (origin 2013, H5, trained on origins <= 2008) and to 2018 (origin 2017, H4, trained on origins <= 2013)
(d) centre: held flat (the current site centre); this round changes only the range, never the centre
rule.accept_country_if_all: the pooled rule passes, and the country has >= 6 H5 windows, the pooled band covers >= 80% of them, and the band rebuilt without the country (leave-country-out, recalibrated) also covers >= 80% of them; and its combined 2022-2026 band (below) is narrower than its current site band. Countries with fewer windows are reported, not changed
rule.application: 'paid' is all goods. Per country, W = the captive products' share of its 2021 purchases from Russia (BACI value), raised each year by the no-war fuel price factor the site's expected path carries (as round 44's Japan LNG split: w_t = s (b_t - (1 - f)) / f / b_t, f = the HS 27 share of 2021 purchases); the cumulative band is the combination of the captive energy band (share W) and the country's current band for the rest (1 - W): half-width = sqrt((W a)^2 + ((1 - W) b)^2 + 2 rho W (1 - W) a b), rho = 0.26 (the owner's value for fuel / non-fuel errors, round 8 / round 44). The current band before the round 51-52 strike adjustment is combined, then the strike widening is added back unchanged. The yearly bands (bmul_lo/hi) are scaled by the same factor per side as the 2022-2026 band
rule.stress_cases: the 2006 and 2009 gas crises (Ukraine transit) and the 2014 shock are reported: errors of the windows that contain them, single-year errors for 2006, 2009 and 2014, and the origin coverage
rule.multiple_testing: one pooled test plus per-country checks; per product and per group (gas, oil) cells are reported as diagnostics, not used to pass anything

verdict: FAILS. The captive energy band (0.567-1.755 for 2022-2026, 206 windows, 21 countries) is 1.36x WIDER in log terms than the site's current band (0.652-1.500), misses 80% coverage at the 2012 origin and covers 84% in the 2014 placebo. No country is changed. Captive energy purchases were not steadier than general trade: price-insensitive supply, yes, but volumes moved with demand, transit crises, domestic output (Romania, Kazakhstan), Belarus's oil disputes and refinery events. Combining the band by energy share would narrow most countries only through the split itself (two imperfectly correlated parts); measured against that split-only baseline the captive band widens every country but Bosnia
